admission.justification: Interpreting damaged records as absence can invite a second agent launch or falsely hide an existing chat.

applicability: Malformed launch receipts during single-document and tree chat discovery.
conditions: Both readers share chat-shape projection and preserve unknown versus known-empty.
Tree corruption is isolated to the document using that receipt.
exclusions: The separate taskless Projects receipt listing is outside this correction.

evidence: mcp/tests/test_role_document_chats.py › DocumentChatTreeTests::test_a_damaged_record_leaves_its_own_document_unknown_and_every_other_answered (18 shapes), DocumentChatReadTests::test_a_damaged_record_refuses_the_read_of_its_document_and_never_fails_it (5 shapes); red before the repair: notes/reports/worker/c41a5d77-92e0-4b18-a3d6-140c0a7e0b50/after-evidence-attempt3/red/red-F02.txt

statement: A damaged launch record makes only its own document unknown in the answer for the tree and is refused with HTTP 409 by the read of the one document; damage is never answered as a document without a chat, and the other documents keep their answers from the one listing of the host.
